findings.title: SQL built by string concatenation from req.query.id reaches pool.query without parameterisation
findings.snippet:
const sql = "SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE id = " + id;
  const result = await pool.query(sql);
findings.description: Source: req.query.id (line 3) is attacker-controlled. Control: line 4 checks presence only; it neither types nor escapes the value. Sink: the concatenated string is passed to pool.query (line 6) with no parameters array, so the driver cannot separate code from data.
findings.impact: Read of arbitrary rows from users and, depending on driver privileges, other tables.
findings.prerequisites: Reachable route; no upstream middleware coerces req.query.id to an integer (none in scope).
findings.remediation: pool.query("SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE id = $1", [id]) and validate id as an integer before the query.
